products.name: Psychedelic Neon Anime Tee — "N.L.B.L.I.T.M.W.I" Graphic T-Shirt
products.description:
This heavyweight garment-dyed tee brings electric, late-night energy to your everyday wardrobe. A vivid, neon-drenched graphic sits boldly on the chest — a surreal, otherworldly character framed by pulsing magenta and electric blue lightning. Subtle vertical lettering down the back adds an artful, streetwise touch that keeps the piece feeling fresh and lived-in. The dye-after-construction process gives the shirt a broken-in softness and slightly muted, vintage color depth that complements the high-contrast print. Wear it when you want to stand out without shouting — at shows, night rides, or just wandering the city at 2 AM.

This shirt moves with the person who loves late-night creativity: DJs, synthwave fans, digital artists, and folks who collect visual oddities. It pairs well with worn denim, layered hoodies, and chunky sneakers. Bring it to small gigs, gallery openings, or meetups where the vibe is neon, analog synths, and conversations that stretch until sunrise.

Product features
- 100% ring-spun US cotton for long-lasting comfort and a soft hand
- Garment-dyed after construction for a vintage, broken-in color and texture
- Heavyweight 6.1 oz fabric with relaxed fit and pre-shrunk stability
- Double-needle stitching and tubular knit (no side seams) for durability and clean lines
- Available S–4XL with sewn-in label and 58 color options

Care instructions
- Machine wash: cold (max 30C or 90F)
- Do not bleach
- Tumble dry: low heat
- Iron, steam or dry: low heat
- Do not dryclean

products.name: Engravable Natural Stone Stretch Bar Bracelet — Amazonite & Howlite Beaded Personalized Bracelet
products.description:
A quietly elegant stretch bracelet that blends natural stone beads with a brushed, engraved stainless steel bar. Smooth round beads — soft pastels in one version and marble-white in another — move easily on an elastic cord for a comfortable, wrist-hugging fit. The low-profile stainless bar carries a subtle permanent etching, adding texture and a refined edge without shouting. Lightweight and hypoallergenic, it slips into everyday life: layered with other bracelets for a curated look or worn alone as a calm, polished accent. Packaged in a white gloss jewelry box with non-tarnish cotton fiber, it arrives ready to gift or tuck into your own jewelry rotation.

Product features
- 316L surgical-grade stainless steel bar — durable and fade-resistant
- 18K PVD gold coating option available for a warm, long-lasting finish
- Hypoallergenic materials to minimize skin irritation
- Permanent engraved design on the brushed steel bar — won’t fade or peel
- Presented in a white gloss jewelry box with non-tarnish cotton fiber

Care instructions
- Wipe the dust or any dirt off gently with a clean, dry cloth.

This plush Arctic fleece blanket brings neon-night energy into quiet moments. Soft, thick polyester fleece wraps you in vibrant electric blues, pinks, and purples that feel alive—like holding a pulse of light. The artwork shows two hands connected by a glowing hourglass and dog tags, giving the piece a charged, nostalgic edge that suits late-night gamers, synthwave fans, or anyone who lives for bold, retro-futuristic style. Drape it over a couch for an instant mood shift, tuck it around your shoulders while streaming or reading, or layer it on a bed to keep the room bright and personal. The one-sided print keeps colors intense where they matter most, while hemmed edges and durable stitching mean this blanket travels with you through many nights and seasons.

Product features
- 100% polyester fleece (315gsm) — thick, fluffy and quick-drying
- Hemmed edges with matched seam thread for lasting durability
- Vibrant, one-sided print with bright, crisp colors
